a: Interactive process viewers for CPU and memory.
vmstat shows processes, memory, swap, IO, and CPU.
iostat reports disk utilization and throughput.
perf profiles CPU at kernel/user level.
strace traces syscalls to find hangs and failures.
lsof lists open files and sockets by process.
ss inspects TCP/UDP sockets and states.
dmesg shows kernel ring buffer messages.
nice/ionice adjust CPU and IO priority.
